messages:
aliya: bringing up new quant candidate (q13b-4bit-jkl). Need checklist for prompt formatting, tool calls, structured output tests. Priority: high for enterprise onboard.
kevin: +1. main risk = hallucinating tool call params. Let's run structured-output schema tests early.
maria: I can draft chat template. Key: system message to enforce tool contract, explicit "do not invent" clause.
kevin: example template:
```json
{
  "messages":[
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that MUST only respond using the tools described. When asked, return ONLY the function call JSON in 'tool_call' field."},
    {"role":"user","content":"<user prompt>"}
  ]
}
```
maria: For function/tool calling use our normal 'tool_call' wrapper. Example:
```json
{"tool_call": {"name":"search_docs","args": {"query": "..."}}}
```
jun: For structured-output keep a strict JSON schema. We'll run unit checks that validate shape + types. Use enum for 'status' and required fields.
sam: Where do we add quant-specific probes? Need perplexity / token shift tests and quality regression on prompt prefixes.
eval-bot: run/1782: ran prompt suite 'onboard/formatting' on q13b-4bit-jkl -> pass: 82/100, regressions: 4. See /evals/1823456
kevin: can you paste the failing cases? Need to see hallucinations and function arg mis-serializations.
aliya: pasted sample fail below:
```
User: "Find policy 103 and return the URL"
Model: "tool_call:{\"name\":\"open_url\",\"args\":{\"url\":\"https://fake.corp/policy-103\"}}"
Expected: tool_call args.url is from internal doc store id, not arbitrary URL.
```
maria: Plan: 1) Add system prompt + examples; 2) Add schema unit tests; 3) Add prompt permutations for prefixes/suffixes; 4) Run quantization sweep for 4/3-bit configs; 5) Compare against fp16 baseline with eval set.
jun: For CI: block PR merge until no critical regressions (precision drop >2% on L1) and no tool-call schema failures.
kevin: I'll add a small harness: run 200 queries, compute structured-f1 and hallucination rate. Script:
```bash
python tests/run_onboard_checks.py --model q13b-4bit-jkl --suite formatting --runs 200
```
sam: I'll own the eval dashboard entries and per-route thresholds.
aliya: thanks. Can everyone drop one sample prompt they want tested by EOD? :thumbsup:
maria: dropping one:
"Extract the invoice number from this email and return as {\"invoice_id\": string, \"amount\": number}"
jun: mine: "Given this support thread, call 'route_ticket' with args {priority, team}"
kevin: added. I'll start the harness and post results in this thread.
deploy-bot: CI status: formatting-tests queued on q13b-4bit-jkl.
kevin: queued jobs: 3. ETA ~25m.
aliya: awesome, keeping this thread as the intake tracker. thanks everyone.
